newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi rice importers seek alternative sources of rice in 1997 after both India and Pakistan, the two main exporters of rice to Saudi Arabia, raised their prices.
- Saudi Arabia to execute 275 educational projects for girls at a cost of 575 million riyals, official says.
- Savola company of Saudi Arabia posts 140 million riyals net profit in 1996.
- King Fahd urges the private sector to play a bigger role in the country's economy by investing in more prjects.
